registryEntry.label: Organization Idle Session Timeout for Web Apps (Entra activity-based timeout policy, 1 hour)
registryEntry.get_command: $p = @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/policies/activityBasedTimeoutPolicies').value | Where-Object { $_.isOrganizationDefault -eq $true }) | Select-Object -First 1; if ($p) { $t = ((@($p.definition)[0] | ConvertFrom-Json).ActivityBasedTimeoutPolicy.ApplicationPolicies | Where-Object { $_.ApplicationId -eq 'default' } | Select-Object -First 1).WebSessionIdleTimeout; [pscustomobject]@{ displayName = $p.displayName; isOrganizationDefault = $p.isOrganizationDefault; webSessionIdleTimeout = $t; idleTimeoutWithinOneHour = [bool]($t -and ([TimeSpan]::Parse($t) -le [TimeSpan]::Parse('01:00:00'))) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 }
registryEntry.set_command: $def = @('{"ActivityBasedTimeoutPolicy":{"Version":1,"ApplicationPolicies":[{"ApplicationId":"default","WebSessionIdleTimeout":"01:00:00"}]}}'); $p = @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/policies/activityBasedTimeoutPolicies').value | Where-Object { $_.isOrganizationDefault -eq $true }) | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $p) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/policies/activityBasedTimeoutPolicies' -Body (@{displayName='CMMC-IdleSessionTimeout';isOrganizationDefault=$true;definition=$def} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; Write-Output 'CMMC-IdleSessionTimeout created' } else { $cur = ((@($p.definition)[0] | ConvertFrom-Json).ActivityBasedTimeoutPolicy.ApplicationPolicies | Where-Object { $_.ApplicationId -eq 'default' } | Select-Object -First 1).WebSessionIdleTimeout; if ((-not $cur) -or ([TimeSpan]::Parse($cur) -gt [TimeSpan]::Parse('01:00:00'))) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method PATCH -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/policies/activityBasedTimeoutPolicies/$($p.id)" -Body (@{definition=$def} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; Write-Output 'organization idle timeout set to 01:00:00' } else { Write-Output 'organization idle timeout already 01:00:00 or shorter' } }
